title: Live ooRexx ↔ SWI-Prolog integration contract
text: Preserve live ooRexx object identity through retained native handles and callback dispatch; do not replace with JSON/RPC snapshots. Preserve Prolog terms, shared variables, unification, lazy backtracking, FIRST/REDO/PRUNED and explicit cut/close. Engine ownership and affinity, generation fencing, nested callbacks and exception-versus-exhaustion semantics are required. The authoritative AlchemyForeignObject and Alchemy Objects packages are external dependencies, not to be fabricated from the reference stub.
